ddl.name: observation_basis_shape
ddl.value: (("basis" = 'leader') = ("basis_reporting_line_id" is not null)) and (("basis" = 'coach') = ("basis_engagement_id" is not null)) and (("basis" = 'designated') = ("basis_designation_id" is not null))

ddl.name: observation_signed_digest
ddl.value: "signed_at" is null or "content_digest" is not null

ddl.name: notification_entity_shape
